mapper.select: SELECT b.*, d.name AS dept_name, a.code AS account_code, a.name AS account_name, a.category AS account_category FROM fin_budget b JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = b.account_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = b.dept_id WHERE b.budget_year = #{year} AND b.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY b.dept_id, a.code
